The primary railway light signals in France are based on standardized signal head shapes ('''châssis-écrans'''), each with two or more lights capable of displaying different [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in France/States|states]] ('''aspects'''). These signal heads and their variations are shown below. Unused light positions are covered, and parasols are not installed.
